title: TRP Coins rewards UI, real Teams UI, and System page with admin-managed Secret Holidays

requirements.summary: Show TRP Coins (900–1000 for non-practice, 0 for practice) on Race Results and use backend-provided award/balance for non-practice races.
acceptanceCriteria: Race Results UI uses the label "TRP Coins" (not generic "Currency") for earned and balance displays.
For non-practice races, the awarded amount displayed on Race Results is an integer within [900, 1000].
For practice races, awarded TRP Coins is 0 and the user balance is not changed.
Awarding TRP Coins is enforced by the backend (frontend cannot directly change balance).

file_operations.description: Update race completion flow to call the backend race-completion capability (completeRace) for non-practice races and store the returned awarded TRP Coins + resulting balance into sessionStorage alongside local metrics; keep practice mode awarding at 0 and do not invoke the crediting capability. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace generic "Earned/Currency" display with "TRP Coins" and render awarded amount and (when available) resulting balance from the backend credit result stored in sessionStorage; ensure practice mode shows 0 TRP Coins and no balance change messaging. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Remove/stop using the local earnedCurrency calculation for non-practice award display (backend is source of truth), while keeping WPM/accuracy/time calculations unchanged; ensure practice mode still displays 0 TRP Coins in results. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update balance labeling to explicitly reference "TRP Coins" (e.g., Balance (TRP Coins)) so user-facing currency wording is consistent across the app. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Update the balance card label to explicitly reference "TRP Coins" for consistent currency naming. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Provide an admin UI and admin-assistant command support to grant arbitrary TRP Coins to a specified user via backend-admin capability.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides an admin-only method to grant TRP Coins to a specified user (including self).
Non-admin callers cannot grant TRP Coins and receive an authorization error.
Admin UI provides a way to input a Principal and an amount, execute the grant, and show success/error feedback.
If the existing admin command assistant is used for currency grants, it supports a command form that clearly grants TRP Coins (and the UI labels it as TRP Coins).

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for admin TRP Coins grants (wrapping backend adminGrantTrpCoins) and related query invalidation (e.g., refresh current user profile/balance after successful grant). Use the authorization component’s role model via existing AdminGuard/isAdmin checks; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace placeholder content with an admin-only TRP Coins grant form: Principal input, amount input (supports very large values), submit action calling the admin grant hook, and clear success/error feedback. Compose existing shadcn-ui components (inputs/buttons/cards) without editing immutable ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend parsing to recognize a TRP Coins-specific command form (e.g., "grant 1000 trp coins to <principal>") and normalize it into a structured action that clearly indicates TRP Coins (not generic currency). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the parsed TRP Coins grant command to actually call the backend admin grant capability (via a hook) and show success/error toasts; ensure UI text labels the currency as "TRP Coins". Use the authorization component via existing AdminGuard gating; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Replace placeholder Teams pages with backend-backed teams list, create-team flow (50,000 TRP Coins), and team details with membership actions that handle member limit errors.
acceptanceCriteria: /teams shows a list of teams from the backend (loading/empty/error states handled).
/teams provides a create-team UI (dialog or inline form) that clearly states the cost: "50,000 TRP Coins".
After successful creation, the new team appears in the list without a full page refresh (React Query invalidation/refetch is acceptable).
/teams/$teamId shows team details and member list from the backend.
Team join/leave (or equivalent) actions update the UI and respect backend errors (including "team full" when at 100 members).

file_operations.description: Replace placeholder teams hooks with React Query hooks calling backend teams capabilities (getTeams, getTeamById, createTeam) plus join/leave hooks once available; include proper loading/empty/error states and query invalidation after mutations. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement Teams list UI backed by the teams hooks, including loading/empty/error states and a create-team flow that clearly states cost "50,000 TRP Coins"; on success, refresh the list via query invalidation/refetch and surface backend errors (e.g., insufficient balance) in English. Compose existing shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement team details page backed by getTeamById with member list rendering and member count/limit display (100 max); add join/leave controls wired to hooks and show backend errors like "team full". Compose existing shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update frontend backend type definitions to reflect the teams membership management capabilities used by the new UI (e.g., join/leave) once they exist, keeping types aligned so the Teams UI can compile against the actor interface. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add a System page in main navigation with Winter/Spring/Summer sections and backend-backed Secret Holidays list, with admin-only add/remove controls.
acceptanceCriteria: The main authenticated navigation includes a link labeled "System" that routes to a new page.
The System page displays Winter, Spring, and Summer as visible sections/tabs.
The System page displays a "Secret Holidays" section listing items from the backend.
Admins can add a new Secret Holiday via UI on the System page (or an admin-only control within it), and non-admin users cannot add/remove Secret Holidays.
Backend persists Secret Holidays and exposes query APIs for all users to read them and admin-only APIs to manage them.

file_operations.description: Create the System page UI with Winter, Spring, and Summer sections (English text) and a "Secret Holidays" section that lists holidays from the backend; show admin-only add/remove controls using existing admin role checks. Compose existing shadcn-ui components; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query hooks to fetch Secret Holidays (getHolidays) and admin mutations to add/remove holidays (addHoliday/removeHoliday) with appropriate cache invalidation. Use the authorization component’s admin gating via existing isAdmin/AdminGuard patterns; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register the new /system route to render SystemPage and include it in the router tree so it is navigable. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a main navigation link labeled "System" visible for authenticated users that routes to /system, consistent with existing nav button styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
